questions.text: What is the diameter of the pilot holes to be drilled into the frame in Drill pilot holes into the frame?
questions.why: The pilot hole size is missing and is critical for the secondary enlargement step.

questions.text: In Verify wiper alignment, should the wiper move slightly in all directions or be firmly seated?
questions.why: The video suggests movement is required, which contradicts the manual's instruction for parts to be properly seated.

questions.text: Is enlarging the mounting holes with a drill an approved technique for the nozzle wiper installation?
questions.why: The manual does not list drills as a required tool and implies the part should be installed as-is.

answers.text: Yes. Power the printer off before reaching inside and move the toolhead by hand only while it is off. Turn it back on only for the G-code position test at the end.
Drill 1/16 inch pilot holes through the template first, then open them up to 1/8 inch.
This is the SteinWipe mod, not the stock wiper. One M3x6 center screw holds the backing plate and two M3x8 screws hold the wiper plate. Bambu's one-screw procedure only applies to the stock wiper.
Use a hex driver that fits the M3 screws from the mod kit. The H2.0 key in the Bambu guide is for the stock wiper screw, which this mod replaces.
Before the outer screws are tightened it should shift slightly side to side, which shows the holes are centred. Once tightened it must be firm with no play.
Only if the wiper binds. You can open the holes up to 3/16 inch as long as the backing plate still clamps flat. This is part of the mod, not the stock Bambu procedure.
